description: Use this when someone wants CISM, CISSP, CISA, AAISM, or AAIA practice questions or sample exam questions, or asks for a quiz or to "test me". No account needed. Returns one scenario question from CertArc's free public practice set: the scenario, its options and a question ID, never the answer. The answer and CertArc's explanations come only from checking the learner's chosen option. Not for real exam questions.
